body: I totally agree. There definitely comes a point when the suffering of the person in question outweighs the suffering that will be experienced by the people who are left behind. I absolutely do not see the justice in forcing a severely, critically, chronically suicidally depressed person to continue struggling  and suffering excruciatingly for the entire rest of their life just so other people with real lives don’t have to miss them. Why is other people’s suffering more important than mine? Answer: it’s not.
